function: F-11.1 — Enable pilot authoring/entry of new UAV flight parameter values (SPD/ALT/HDG); UAV-scoped twin of R01's function, same teleology with a distinct target (the UAV rather than ownship autopilot).
function_summary: UAV flight parameter authoring (SPD/ALT/HDG) — UAV-scoped twin of R01
behaviour: Be-11.1.1 (Touch-only): Pilot opens the UAV param panel on WAD, taps a field (SPD/ALT/HDG) to focus it, enters the value via an on-screen touch keypad, and taps CONFIRM (gated by envelope validation). Be-11.1.2 (Keyboard-only): Pilot selects the target field via bezel OSS or UCP, enters/steps the value via UCP alphanumeric keyboard or bezel rotary, and confirms via a dedicated CONFIRM OSS. Be-11.1.3 (Mixed): Pilot touches a field to focus it, types the value on the UCP keyboard, and confirms via touch or OSS. Together the three provide modality-complete redundancy; validation (F-11.2) and UAV ack (F-11.3) are reused behaviours referenced at CONFIRM and step 5.2.7.
behaviour_summary: Multi-modal UAV parameter entry with envelope-validated confirmation
structure: S-11.1 — R01 structure pattern re-instantiated as a separate, concurrently-displayable UAV PARAMS panel with its own state. New WAD overlay panel instance (SPD/ALT/HDG fields, on-screen touch keypad, CONFIRM button), layout cloned from R01's AP panel and co-displayable so ownship and UAV authoring run in parallel; own UAV-param state model distinct from ownship AP state. Reused as same instances: envelope-validation gate, R02 ack/confirmation framework, and shared bezel OSS/rotary + UCP alphanumeric keyboard hardware, context-bound to this panel's focus.
structure_summary: Concurrent UAV PARAMS panel cloned from R01 AP layout.
